enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Frozen Depths Lore +8: Passive: Your Negative, Poison and Cold spells gain a +8% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Frozen Depths +53: Passive: +53 Equipment bonus to Negative, Cold and Poison Spell Power.
Spell Penetration +3: Passive: +3 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Bless Ward: You are warded against the Bless spell.
Bane of the Depths: Your Negative, Poison and Cold spells automatically apply the effects of Bane to enemies struck.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
